repairs.quote: Xin Zhao slashes, dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage, then thrusts, dealing (50/85/120/155/190 + (90% Attack Damage) + (65% Ability Power)) × (1 + 33.3% Critical Strike Chance). Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by 50% for (1.5 + (0.5% Ability Power)) seconds. Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for 3 seconds and revealed unless Stealthed. The thrust's damage is increased by up to 33.3% based on Xin Zhao's Critical Strike Chance. Deals (50 ~ 100)% damage to minions. Applies Lifesteal at 33% effectiveness on both attacks.
